Per-sequence physicochemical descriptors

Source: R/pepchem.R
peptide_properties.Rd

Computes the peptide-chemistry descriptors behind the 07_pepchem report. Duplicated sequences are computed once and returned once, so this is safe to call with the whole Sequence column of a long pep_all table.

Usage

peptide_properties(sequences, ph = 7.4)

Arguments

sequences

Character vector of peptide sequences (unmodified, one-letter code). NA and empty strings are dropped.

ph

pH at which the net Charge is computed. Default 7.4.

Value

A data frame with one row per unique sequence: Sequence, Length, GRAVY, MW, pI, Charge, Boman, HydrophobicMoment, InstabilityIndex, AliphaticIndex and one frac_<class> column per amino-acid class. Zero rows when no usable sequence is supplied.

Details

GRAVY is the grand average of hydropathy, the mean Kyte-Doolittle value of the residues (Kyte & Doolittle 1982) and the standard hydrophobicity summary for a peptide — exactly what Peptides::hydrophobicity() returns with scale = "KyteDoolittle". pI, Charge, Boman, HydrophobicMoment, InstabilityIndex and AliphaticIndex come from the corresponding Peptides functions. The frac_* columns are the fraction of residues in each amino-acid class (the classes Peptides::aaComp() reports), derived here from the composition matrix rather than by calling aaComp(), which returns a per-sequence list and does not vectorise.

Non-standard residues (X, B, Z, U) are ignored by the composition and the class fractions; the Peptides descriptors apply their own rules.

Examples

peptide_properties(c("SIINFEKL", "GILGFVFTL"))
#>    Sequence Length    GRAVY       MW       pI       Charge     Boman
#> 1  SIINFEKL      8 0.487500 963.1416 6.408784 -0.005127052  0.582500
#> 2 GILGFVFTL      9 2.266667 966.1881 6.099982 -0.005093736 -2.674444
#>   HydrophobicMoment InstabilityIndex AliphaticIndex frac_Tiny frac_Small
#> 1         0.3755167        -20.65000       146.2500 0.1250000  0.2500000
#> 2         0.2503661         20.85556       162.2222 0.3333333  0.4444444
#>   frac_Aliphatic frac_Aromatic frac_NonPolar frac_Polar frac_Charged frac_Basic
#> 1      0.3750000     0.1250000     0.5000000  0.5000000         0.25      0.125
#> 2      0.4444444     0.2222222     0.8888889  0.1111111         0.00      0.000
#>   frac_Acidic
#> 1       0.125
#> 2       0.000
